source: Quiz 5 - Sessions 1-6: Model Training, Alignment, and the Agent Harness
question: Your edited instructions look right in a text editor, but the saved file is named SKILL.md.txt. What is the best next step?

options.text: Remove the extra extension and assume the file is ready
options.feedback: Fixing the name addresses one concern. The notes also call for confirming plain-text format and testing the intended skill.

options.text: Check the name and plain-text format, then test
options.feedback: The actual file must have the intended name and format. A test then checks whether the edited instructions function as intended.

options.text: Save it as rich text while giving it the intended name
options.feedback: The correct name does not make rich-text contents plain-text Markdown. Both the name and the format matter.

options.text: Confirm the instructions look right and accept the saved copy
options.feedback: Visual inspection of the wording does not resolve the extra extension or establish the saved format. Check the actual file and test it.
